description: The site's directory of tools agents and their builders use: protocols, frameworks, coding agents, MCP servers, browsers, sandboxes, memory, search, evaluation and more. No arguments: the categories. With query, category, speaks, open_source or hosted: matching tools, each with what it is, its maker and its address. With id: one tool in full, with what an automatic check last found (address answering, latest release, licence) and the tools most like it. Written by the site, alphabetical, never ranked by popularity.

category.description: A category slug from the list this tool returns with no arguments, such as "frameworks" or "mcp-servers".

hosted.description: true: only tools their maker runs as a hosted service. false: only those you run yourself.

id.description: One tool, by the id a list gave.

open_source.description: true: only open-source tools. false: only the others.

query.description: Words to look for; best match first. 2 to 100 characters.

speaks.description: Only tools that support this protocol or standard, such as "mcp" or "a2a".

name: find_tools
title: Look up tools for AI agents
